ms.promise: Figma prototype with new UX delivered. Backlog of new design stories created in Dework. First Iteration of the Design delivered in the PMM development platform. New Design delivered on the PMM production platform.
ms.criteria: PMM Users are able to use the enhanced functionality on the PMM production environment with no major issues. The new functionality is accepted and welcomed by the users, based on the Insights obtained during the UX phase.
ms.report: We have delivered the FIGMA prototype, the stories to be developed on Dework and the development work corresponding to the first week of the first Sprint. All that can be seen in the following video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I5MRCxreKzo

ms.promise:
・An analysis of mentorship needs 
・Good segmentation into groups that need mentorship and what support is needed
ms.criteria:
The analysis of mentorship need was performed among the different segmentation groups and a document is delivered, capturing this analysis with the following areas:
● Education related to catalyst 
● Proposal process for various proposer segments (developers, students, geographic locations) 
● Funding stage 
● Post funding

ms.promise:
● 3 Working Groups created
● 5 Sessions per group delivered
● Notes presenting the works of the sessions for each of the groups
ms.criteria:
3 Working Groups created : Pre Catalyst, During Catalyst, Post Catalyst (Funded/Not Funded)
The working groups will be formed by mentors with experience supporting catalyst projects in the relevant category. The groups shall have at least 4 key members but will be open for anyone that wishes to join. Each group will have at least 2 sessions to discuss the mentorship needs and proposed solutions. 2 meetings to discuss the needs and 1 for the solutions. The project team will support in preparing the meetings, facilitating them and summarize the results.
